# Marine Creatures

> Bringing Ocean at your Doorstep. Luxury marine design house, bespoke living reef installations, and specialized aquaculture studio based in Kolkata, West Bengal, India.

Marine Creatures is an authoritative marine aquatics design studio founded by Suraj Shasmal. We engineer museum-grade living coral reef ecosystems, architectural aquariums for luxury residences and corporate sanctuaries, and supply quarantine-conditioned marine species and premium equipment across India.

## Core Architectural & Biological Services

- [Turnkey Marine Aquarium Installation](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/installation): Bespoke architectural marine aquarium design, Schedule 80 concealed plumbing, structural floor load engineering, 14-day automated biological cycling, and quarantined livestock introduction. Turnkey commissions start from ₹35,000.
- [Aquarium Renovation & Biological Restoration](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/renovation): Complete ecosystem revival for troubled, cloudy, scratched, or imbalanced marine tanks. Features optical acrylic/glass diamond polishing, silent DC life-support retrofitting, and our 100% zero-loss livestock temporary staging protocol. Restorations start from ₹15,000.
- [White-Glove Marine Concierge Maintenance](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/services#maintenance): Scheduled bi-weekly care visits, laboratory-grade RO/DI and salt water exchange, ICP-OES trace element balancing, reef grooming, and 24/7 priority emergency response. Subscription plans start from ₹18,500 / month.
- [Aquarium Design Philosophy](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/aquarium-design): Living architectural philosophies, custom cabinetry integration, and biotope selection.
- [Our Worlds Portfolio](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/our-worlds): Architectural case studies across luxury estates, penthouses, and commercial headquarters in Kolkata and Eastern India.

## Product Catalogue & Equipment

- [Marketplace](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/marketplace): Full catalog of living marine fish, corals, specialized lighting, protein skimmers, and chemistry.
- [Aquarium Lighting Tech](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/marketplace/lighting): NemoLight Extreme and app-controlled LED fixtures calibrated for SPS/LPS photosynthetic active radiation (PAR).
- [Fish & Reef Life](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/marketplace?category=marine-life): Captive-bred and quarantine-certified marine fish (clownfish pairs, tangs, angels, blennies).
- [Salts & Reef Chemistry](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/marketplace?category=salt-chemistry): Probiotic marine salts with included batch ICP-OES test reports, synthetic adsorbent resins, buffer solutions.
- [Equipment & Protein Skimmers](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/marketplace?category=hardware): DC variable-speed protein skimmers, return pumps, wavemakers, and filtration reactors.

## Authoritative Educational & Care Guides

- [Marine Aquarium Setup & Care Guide](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/guides/marine-aquarium-setup-guide): Complete water chemistry standards (Salinity 1.025 SG, pH 8.1–8.4, 8–9 dKH), nitrogen cycle biology, and filtration setup.
- [Aquarium Installation Cost Factors](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/guides/aquarium-installation-cost-factors): Transparent breakdown of installation pricing factors in India (dimensions, glass vs acrylic, filtration tier, starts at ₹35,000).
- [Reef Tank Lighting & PAR Selection](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/guides/reef-tank-lighting-par-guide): Spectrum distribution, ultraviolet channels, and PAR targets for soft corals, LPS, and high-light SPS.
- [Marine Fish Compatibility & Acclimation](https://www.marinecreatures.co.in/guides/marine-fish-compatibility): Reef-safe species selection, clownfish pairing dynamics, and drip-acclimation procedures.
